svg.text: FaceTrackDB: relational schema (18 tables, from the live PostgreSQL 16 database)

PK = primary key, FK = part of a foreign key, NN = NOT NULL. A line joins a foreign key (crow’s foot = many side) to the key it references (double bar = one side). Colours: blue people, green hostel, teal faces, orange activity, red violations, grey bookkeeping.

Lines pass behind boxes that lie between two tables. Delete rules: student_parent, face_profiles and b_consents cascade from students; every other foreign key is NO ACTION. See 03-relational-model.md.
